BI_HMC.notes: Separate exact-IIR Bayesian HMC sampler. Posterior mean in original coefficient coordinates; Gaussian physical priors and inverse-gamma innovation variance. Explicit observed prehistory/noise burn-in overrides the stationary boundary default. K_max and optimizer convergence tolerances do not set the sampling budget.

RGLS.notes: Placeholder. Jacobian of parameter-to-loss mapping is extracted.

WS_GNI.notes: Newton-style update using autodiff gradient and Hessian of the non-oracle FSM prediction-error loss.

WS_GGHAM_1_dH.notes: First-order gradient-root GHAM update using autodiff gradient and diagonal Hessian approximation from the non-oracle FSM prediction-error loss. Tuned on lambda_g=2000, sigma_nu=0.1.

WS_GGHAM_2_I.notes: Second-order gradient-root GHAM update using autodiff gradient and Hessian with identity linear operator on the non-oracle FSM prediction-error loss.

WS_GGHAM_2_dH.notes: Second-order gradient-root GHAM update using autodiff gradient and Hessian with diagonal-Hessian linear operator on the non-oracle FSM prediction-error loss.

WS_GGHAM_2_H.notes: Second-order gradient-root GHAM update using autodiff gradient and Hessian with Hessian linear operator on the non-oracle FSM prediction-error loss.

WS_LGHAM_1_TIK.notes: First-order loss-root GHAM update on the nonlinear FSM innovation-energy criterion.

WS_LGHAM_3_TIK.notes: Third-order loss-root GHAM update on the nonlinear FSM innovation-energy criterion.
